import os
base='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u050/system/state/workspace'; os.makedirs(base+'/programs',exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Read the repeated color strip; its colors define the top-to-bottom copies.
    colors=[]
    for j in range(w):
        vals=[grid[i][j] for i in range(h) if grid[i][j]!=0]
        if vals and len(set(vals))==1:
            colors.append(vals[0])
    # Identify the repeated template: largest contiguous nonzero component, excluding strip.
    cells={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]!=0}
    comps=[]
    while cells:
        seed=cells.pop(); comp={seed}; stack=[seed]
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in cells: cells.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    shape=max(comps,key=len)
    # Choose the glyph-shaped component (not the color strip).
    minr=min(r for r,c in shape); minc=min(c for r,c in shape)
    maxr=max(r for r,c in shape); maxc=max(c for r,c in shape)
    # For connected glyphs, recover rows/cols and normalize.
    pat={(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in shape}
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    top=max(0,(h-len(colors)*(maxr-minr+1))//2)
    for k,col in enumerate(colors):
        for r,c in pat:
            rr=top+k*(maxr-minr+1)+r
            cc=minc+c
            if rr<h and cc<w: out[rr][cc]=col
    return out
'''
open(base+'/programs/task-979f3049.py','w').write(code)
